steps: Progress through the opening story missions.
Complete all objectives in chapter 1 of the main quest line.

achievements.name: Master Camper
achievements.description: Complete the activation of the camp at Howling Hill.

steps: Travel to Howling Hill in the open world.
Interact with the camp site and complete the activation process.
Progress through the main story to chapter 7.
Complete all objectives in the Pailune storyline.
Complete every chapter of the main quest line.
Watch the final cutscene to confirm completion.
Locate all sanctums scattered across the world.
Complete the combat or puzzle challenge inside each sanctum.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Some sanctums only unlock after story progression. Check back after completing the main quest.

steps: Find all spire locations on the map.
Complete each spire's unique challenge to claim the reward.
Unlock New Power challenges through story progression.
Defeat all required beasts to complete every challenge.

achievements.name: Proud Returnee
achievements.description: Complete the camp relocation to Pailune.

steps: Progress the main story until the camp relocation quest triggers.
Complete the relocation objectives to move camp to Pailune.
Equip a sword weapon type.
Complete every sword-specific combat challenge in the training system.
Discover all Abyss dungeon entrances.
Clear each Abyss dungeon and defeat the boss within.
Equip a spear weapon type.
Complete every spear-specific combat challenge.
Find all maze dungeon entrances across the world.
Navigate and complete each maze to earn the reward.
Find constellation puzzle locations (often at elevated points).
Solve each constellation puzzle by aligning the stars correctly.
Equip a shield-based weapon setup.
Complete every shield-specific combat challenge.
Locate all ancient ruins across the map.
Solve the puzzles within each ruin.
Equip a bow weapon type.
Complete every bow-specific combat challenge.
Discover all hidden secret locations in the world.
Complete the challenge or interaction at each secret place.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Secret places are often behind destructible walls, underwater, or require specific traversal abilities.

achievements.name: Master of Rapiers
achievements.description: Complete all rapier and shield challenges.

steps: Equip rapier and shield weapon setup.
Complete every rapier-specific combat challenge.
Equip a two-handed weapon type.
Complete every two-handed weapon combat challenge.
Equip a firearm weapon type.
Complete every gun-specific combat challenge.
Access the training system from camp or training grounds.
Complete every training challenge across all weapon types and difficulty tiers.
Equip cannon/artillery weapons.
Complete every cannon-specific combat challenge.
Access battle challenges from the challenge menu.
Complete all large-scale battle encounters.
Find and collect all special equipment scattered across the world.
Complete the challenges tied to each special equipment piece.
Find and tame various horses across the world.
Complete all horse-related challenges including races and combat.
Accept hunting challenges from the challenge board.
Hunt all target creatures and complete every hunting challenge.
Explore every region of the map thoroughly.
Complete all exploration milestones and discoveries.
Access operation challenges from the challenge menu.
Complete all tactical operation missions.
Engage with the trading system across different settlements.
Complete all trade routes and fulfill every trade challenge.

achievements.name: Shadowlord
achievements.description: Complete all Above the Law challenges.

steps: Engage with the outlaw/criminal side activities.
Complete all 'Above the Law' challenge objectives.

achievements.name: Lord of Honor
achievements.description: Complete all Challenges and Changes challenges.

steps: Access the Challenges and Changes category.
Complete every challenge in this category.
Find all minigames across the world (card games, dice, etc.).
Complete every minigame challenge to earn the reward.
Mastery challenges unlock after completing specific categories.
Complete the final mastery challenge in every category.
Engage with farming, fishing, cooking, and crafting systems.
Complete every life skill challenge.
